summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by LATAM Airlines Group S.A., a foreign private issuer, reporting its operating statistics for April 2026. It discloses passenger traffic, capacity, load factor, and cargo data for its domestic and international segments. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or management change is referenced. The filing is purely an operational update and does not trigger any special-situations categorization.
